claims.statement: Snowflake documentation separates AI Credits from Platform Credits. AI Functions, Cortex Code, Agents, Search, Batch Search and document parsing use AI Credit pricing; fine-tuning and the Analyst API remain on Platform Credits.
Listed AI Credit rates are $2.00 for global routing and $2.20 for regional routing, before automatic discounts based on annual contract value.
The pricing documentation includes an example with Platform Credits at $3 and AI Credits at $2, 100 of each, totaling $500.
An alert is a notification and should not be assumed to stop every workload or charge.
